versions.changelog: v1.1.3: Make trilingual EN/FR/ZH the latest version (was 0.1.1/0.1.6, semver too low)
v1.1.2: ClawHub version with trilingual SKILL.md (EN/FR/ZH) and cluster-jargon-free description
v1.1.1: Re-publish with updated SKILL.md (trilingual, FR/ZH added)

**v1.1.0 — Multi-algorithm hash utility with expanded features and improved robustness**

- Added support for verifying MANIFEST files containing hashes.
- Introduced JSON output mode for easier scripting and automation.
- Enhanced CLI with file comparison (`--compare`) and streaming from stdin.
- Improved determinism and performance tests (40 test cases in total).
- Fixed issues with handling empty input (e.g., `/dev/null`).
